text:
If you're chasing sun before the pattern flips, today's the day: mostly sunny, a high near 84, low humidity and a light south wind that keeps things comfortable. Air quality's good, though there's wildfire smoke worth watching if a denser plume drifts in. On the lake, south winds 5 to 15 knots with waves 1 to 3 feet, water's a pleasant 73, so it's a genuinely nice day out there. Tonight stays mild and partly cloudy near 66.

Monday still looks mostly sunny with a high near 86, but the forecasters are watching a slow pattern change kick in, with a slight chance of afternoon showers and storms after 3pm. The models mostly agree it stays dry through midday, though rain chances jump overnight as winds on the lake build to 15-20 knots by evening, so plan any paddling or sailing for daytime. Beyond Monday, confidence is growing for a wetter, stormier stretch Tuesday into Wednesday as a bigger system approaches, worth watching but not worth worrying about yet. Bottom line: get outside today and Monday daytime, good waterfront window through early evening, but have an indoor backup ready by Monday night.
